loadChosenDeck game playerId dl = case barkhamDeckRejection game dl <|> joinDeckRejection game playerId dl.investigator of
loadChosenDeck :: Game -> PlayerId -> ArkhamDBDecklist -> DB Reply

barkhamDeckRejection :: Game -> ArkhamDBDecklist -> Maybe Text
barkhamDeckRejection game dl
  | isBarkham && not barkhamInvestigator = Just "This scenario requires a Barkham investigator."
  | not isBarkham && (barkhamInvestigator || barkhamCards) = Just "Barkham characters and cards can only be used in The Meddling of Meowlathotep."
  | otherwise = Nothing
 where
  isBarkham = case gameMode game of
    That s -> s.id == ":barkham:022"
    These _ s -> s.id == ":barkham:022"
    _ -> False
  barkhamInvestigator = unInvestigatorId dl.investigator `elem` [":barkham:001", ":barkham:004", ":barkham:007", ":barkham:010", ":barkham:013"]
  barkhamCards = any (T.isPrefixOf ":barkham:" . unCardCode) (Map.keys dl.slots <> Map.keys dl.sideSlots)
